title: Jääkärien jäljiltä: Kymmenen kertomusta
summary: "Jääkärien jäljiltä: Kymmenen kertomusta" by Jalmari Kara is a collection of short stories written in the early 20th century. The narrative paints a vivid picture of her longing and curiosity, intermingled with anxiety and confusion about the intentions of the boy she admires. As the tension builds, the girl wrestles with her feelings and the societal expectations surrounding her, breaking the delicate balance of youth, romance, and the looming specter of war in the backdrop of her life.
